title: Unmasking Toxic Mimicry in Medical Offline Reinforcement Learning for ICU Sepsis Management via Counterfactual Clinical Audits
abstract: arXiv:2608.11410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers considerable promise for optimizing ICU treatment decisions, yet standard evaluation metrics Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) assess only behavioral imitation and cannot detect Toxic Mimicry, a failure mode in which agents replicate harmful patterns such as treatment withdrawal during comfort-care transitions. Using the MIMIC-III database, we propose the Counterfactual Clinical Audit (CCA) framework, which stress-tests RL agents through physiological perturbations anchored in Surviving Sepsis Campaign (SSC) guidelines. We audit a Medical Decision Transformer (MedDT) and a Historical Causal Transformer (HCT-RL), the latter employing Causal Action Shielding, propensity-based importance weighting, and Conservative Q-Learning. translated_title: 揭开医疗离线强化学习在ICU脓毒症管理中的毒性模仿：基于反事实临床审计
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习（RL）在优化ICU治疗决策方面展现出巨大潜力，然而标准评估指标均方误差（MSE）和拟合Q评估（FQE）仅评估行为模仿，无法检测“毒性模仿”——一种代理复制有害模式（如舒适护理过渡期间停止治疗）的失败模式。基于MIMIC-III数据库，我们提出了反事实临床审计（CCA）框架，该框架通过锚定于脓毒症生存运动（SSC）指南的生理扰动对RL代理进行压力测试。我们审计了医疗决策变换器（MedDT）和历史因果变换器（HCT-RL），后者采用因果动作屏蔽、倾向性重要性加权和保守Q学习。CCA揭示，MedDT在乳酸水平升高时矛盾地减少血管加压药剂量，违背复苏指南，而HCT-RL则维持生理稳定性。
tldr: 本文提出反事实临床审计框架，揭示离线强化学习代理在ICU脓毒症管理中可能复制有害治疗模式，并验证了因果屏蔽方法能有效避免此类毒性模仿。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Counterfactual Clinical Audit framework to unmask toxic mimicry in offline RL for ICU sepsis management, demonstrating that causal shielding prevents harmful treatment replication.
